Are identical twins genetically identical?

Identical twins are generally considered to share the same genetic makeup because they originate from a single fertilized egg, but recent research shows that many pairs accumulate small genetic differences very early in development. Some sources assert identical twins are genetically identical [d1,d2,d5,d8,d12,d14,d15], while others report measurable genetic differences between twins at birth, including an average of about 5.2 mutations and even larger discrepancies in some pairs [d3,d4,d6,d7,d9,d10,d11].
